method: A four-table mechanical sampler learns the frequencies of all certain paragraph word types in four relative line-position bins on ZL public training pages. It samples a public-training line length, draws each table cell independently with fixed seed 390291, and writes the artificial word zzzzzzzzzz in every fourth slot as a guard against copying any four-word manuscript phrase. The table does not name or classify the sh/ch contrast; its general position tables retain every training-word positional tendency. It assumes word spaces and advance knowledge of line length. The artificial filler and copied vocabulary are features of the construction, not a reading. Fit uses no held-out pages. This is the unchanged position-table output submitted in R-047 against F-029, reused to test whether the same general procedure also reproduces F-030; the sampler was not refitted for the k/t contrast.
